title: On the Cohomology of Cyclic Associative Algebras
summary: We introduce a cohomology theory for cyclic associative algebras, a subclass of shift associative algebras defined by the identity $(xy)z = x(yz) = y(zx)$. This cohomology, denoted $H^\bullet_{\mathrm{cyc}}(A, M)$, is a subtheory of Hochschild cohomology obtained by restricting to cochains that satisfy a cyclic compatibility condition derived from the defining identity. We prove that $H^2_{\mathrm{cyc}}(A, M)$ classifies cyclic associative extensions of $A$ by a cyclic bimodule $M$.
